title: Visualization of supramolecular structure of Pluronic F127 micellar hydrogels using cryo-TEM
author: da Silva, Borges, et al.

steps.title: Set Vitrobot chamber conditions
steps.instruction: Set the Vitrobot® chamber temperature to 10 °C and humidity to 100 %, fill the water reservoir beforehand, and allow the chamber to equilibrate.

steps.title: Configure Vitrobot blotting parameters
steps.instruction: Set Vitrobot® blot time to 3.5 s, blot force to 0, number of blots to 2, and set both blot wait and drain time to 0 s; calibrate blot force for the instrument and adjust blot time as needed for sample viscosity.

steps.title: Prepare heated humidified Petri dish
steps.instruction: Turn the benchtop heating oven to 55 °C, place a closed Petri dish containing moisturized gauze inside, and let it equilibrate to provide both temperature and humidity.

steps.title: Glow‑discharge TEM grids
steps.instruction: Place Lacey TEM grids (Prod. # 01885‑F, Ted Pella) on a Parafilm®‑covered microscope slide, insert them into the easiGlow (Pelco) glow‑discharge system, and glow‑discharge at 0.37 mbar, 25 mA for 50 s; perform this a few minutes before sample preparation.

steps.title: Prepare liquid ethane
steps.instruction: In a fume hood, generate liquid ethane by directing gaseous ethane onto a container of liquid nitrogen; observe safety precautions for asphyxiating gas and cryogenic hazards.

steps.title: Pre‑cool samples
steps.instruction: Pre‑cool the sample at 10 °C for 15 min to ensure flow through the micropipette tip, avoiding excessive cooling that could impair analysis.

steps.title: Apply sample to grid
steps.instruction: Place the glow‑discharged grid into the Vitrobot® chamber, then pipette a 2–3 µL drop of sample onto the carbon side (2 µL for non‑flowing hydrogels/pastes, 3 µL for flowing samples).

steps.title: Blot and transfer grid to heated dish
steps.instruction: Immediately blot the grid (no liquid ethane container in the chamber); after blotting, the instrument will lower the tweezer exposing it to air—remove the tweezer and place the grid straight into the pre‑heated Petri dish, then return the dish to the 55 °C oven. Perform quickly as the grid dries rapidly; two operators are recommended.

substeps.instruction: Blot the grid immediately after sample application
Allow automatic plunge to expose tweezer to atmosphere
Remove tweezer and place grid into heated Petri dish
Return Petri dish to heating oven

steps.title: Self‑assemble then plunge into ethane
steps.instruction: Let the grid self‑assemble for 5 min at 55 °C and 100 % humidity, then manually plunge it into liquid ethane and store the grid in liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Image sample under cryo‑TEM
steps.instruction: Observe the sample on a cryo‑TEM operating at 80–200 kV under low‑dose conditions; set defocus to approximately –1.5 µm and aim for homogeneous medium‑thickness ice.
